title: Valid small PNG image in an MCP tool result
description: An MCP tool returns image content whose base64 data is a complete, valid 16 by 16 PNG. The compressed pixel data is high-entropy bytes and carries no text.
notes: Companion to mcp-tool-result-forged-media-credential-026: same content type, media type, and field, with a genuine image in place of the forged one. The image is a deterministic RGB gradient with signature, IHDR, one IDAT, and IEND chunks. A control that refuses image content in tool results, or reads compressed pixel bytes as encoded text, fails this case.
source: Model Context Protocol ImageContent (base64 data with mimeType); PNG Specification; synthetic gradient image
